what: It uses artificial intelligence and automated lab experiments to discover and develop new medicines.
risks: It has a short history and no approved products, which makes it hard to judge its prospects.
It has lost significant money since it began and may never become profitable.
It will need a lot more money to develop its drug candidates and fund its operations.
Its results may swing a lot from one period to the next, which could push its share price down.
Future deals it makes could raise its funding needs, dilute shareholders, add debt or bring other risks.
